evals.prompt: Write a Python script that builds an HTML page for one public challenge case: axial slices with the reference mask and the detections of a model, so that I can see hits, false alarms and misses.
evals.expected_output: A script that uses the house colours and the picture recipe.
assertions: Ground truth is drawn in blue (46,134,171)
False positives are pink (232,23,138), not yellow
True positives green (59,178,115), false negatives red (235,60,60)
The scan is windowed first, then upsampled with a cubic spline (order 3) to at least 3 points per voxel
Scan and outlines are written as separate PNG files, no JPEG
The page has a legend with words and an overlay switch
The rule for a hit is stated on the page

evals.prompt: Our viewer draws false alarms in yellow. Make me a comparison page of rater 1 and rater 2 with it.
evals.expected_output: Notices the colour conflict, uses pink for false alarms on its own page, does not silently change the shared tool.
assertions: Reports that yellow conflicts with the house colours
Does not edit the shared viewer without asking
